method.source: GPM IMERG Final daily V07 via NASA GES DISC Giovanni, 2001-2024
method.dry_spell: longest run of days < 2.5 mm in the 30 days starting the 1st of the sowing month
method.ne_onset: first day from 10 Oct with >= 20 mm over 3 days and no 10+ day dry spell (< 2.5 mm) in the next 30 days (agro-meteorological onset; IMD's official onset uses winds and coastal stations)
method.sowing_rain_onset: same rule searching from 15 Sep: first reliable sowing rains (includes late southwest-monsoon / transition rain used for Purattasi-pattam sowing)
